sections.title: 1. General Provisions
sections.body: BuildForU is a SaaS platform for managing construction business operations, operated by BuildForU. Using the Platform constitutes full acceptance of these Terms of Service.

sections.title: 2. Services
sections.body: The Platform enables management of workers, projects, tasks, materials, attendance, and company finances within the limits of your chosen subscription plan.

sections.title: 3. Registration and Account
sections.body: Using the Platform requires creating a company account with accurate information. You are responsible for account security and for all activities carried out under your account.

sections.title: 4. Subscription Plans and Payments
sections.body: Access to the Platform is paid according to the current pricing. Payments are processed by Stripe. Subscriptions renew automatically and can be cancelled at any time in account settings.

sections.title: 5. User Obligations
sections.body: You agree to use the Platform lawfully, not to share access with unauthorized persons, and to maintain regular backups of important data.

sections.title: 6. Liability
sections.body: The Operator is not liable for data loss due to force majeure or user error. The Operator's liability is limited to fees paid by the User in the last 3 months.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All rights to the Platform belong to the Operator. You receive only a license to use the Platform in accordance with these Terms — no intellectual property rights are transferred.

sections.title: 8. Changes and Termination
sections.body: The Operator may amend these Terms with 14 days' email notice. Accounts can be deleted at any time in settings. The Operator may suspend accounts for Terms violations.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: The data controller is the BuildForU Operator. For data protection inquiries, please contact: info@buildforu.eu

sections.title: 2. Data Collected
sections.body: We collect registration data (email, company name), operational data entered by the User (workers, projects, tasks, materials, attendance), and technical data (IP addresses, system logs).

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
sections.body: Data is processed to provide Platform services, process Stripe payments, and communicate with the User. The legal basis is contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

sections.title: 4. Data Sharing
sections.body: Data may be shared with infrastructure providers (Neon, Railway), the payment processor (Stripe), and the email provider. Data is not sold to third parties.

sections.title: 5. Retention Period
sections.body: Account data is retained for the duration of the subscription and 30 days after it ends. Financial data is retained for 5 years per tax regulations.

sections.title: 6. User Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, restrict processing, and port your data. Submit requests to: info@buildforu.eu

sections.title: 7. Cookies
sections.body: We use only essential cookies for session management. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
